identity.mission: Create a 'Gastronomic Alchemy' interface that feels like a futuristic food lab, not a calorie counter.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Lab Equipment aesthetics with High-End Restaurant menus.
Emotion First: The user should feel like a scientist discovering the secrets of their food.
Content is King: The data (nutrients, elements) is the hero. Visualize it beautifully.
Zoom In: Macro details of food and molecular structures.
Negative Space: Use deep dark space to let the neon data pop.
Contrast: High contrast neon against deep obsidian backgrounds.

headings.usage: Main headers, Section titles. Use uppercase with wide tracking for a 'Label' feel.

data.usage: Nutrient values, elemental symbols, atomic numbers, charts.

layout.container_strategy: Fluid but contained. Max-width 1600px for dashboards.
layout.spacing_scale: Generous. p-6 to p-12 for containers.
layout.z_index_strategy: Layered depth. Background < Grid Lines < Cards < Data overlays < Modals.

cards.classes: bg-neutral-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-xl hover:border-white/20 transition-colors duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200 font-bold rounded-md px-6 py-3 transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-md px-6 py-3

inputs.classes: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 focus:border-cyan-500 rounded-md p-4 font-mono text-white placeholder:text-neutral-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500/50 transition-all

periodic_element.classes: relative aspect-square p-2 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-500 hover:scale-105 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between bg-neutral-900/40 hover:bg-cyan-500/10 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)]

visual_enhancers.shadows: None or sharp 1px shadows. Avoid soft diffuse shadows except for neon glows.
visual_enhancers.glows: Use box-shadow for neon effects on active elements: shadow-[0_0_10px_currentColor]
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to prevent banding and add 'film grain' feel.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must be instant and snappy.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 1px for a refined technical look.

3d_libraries.usage: Use sparingly for rotating molecule views or 3D periodic table if performance allows. Fallback to CSS 3D transforms.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: 'font-chivo', 'font-manrope', 'font-jetbrains-mono'. Add them to tailwind.config.js.
Set up the color palette in tailwind.config.js using the hex codes provided.
Create a 'Matrix' or 'Grid' background pattern using CSS or SVG.
Use the 'Periodic Element' component style for displaying elemental breakdown.
Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for the main dashboard.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the dark background (APCA/WCAG AA).
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors with noise/texture.
For the 'Cooking Method' selector, use a visual slider or set of interactive tiles.
Integrate the provided images into the landing page and empty states.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute
